content: Next.js 16 App Router: next/dynamic with ssr:false MUST be in a 'use client' file — if placed in a Server Component, Next.js throws: 'ssr: false is not allowed with next/dynamic in Server Components. Please move it into a Client Component.' This is a BUILD-TIME error, not just runtime. To confirm isolation: check that the Server Component page.tsx imports HeroSection (which is 'use client') NOT HeroScene directly. The dynamic() call with ssr:false should live inside the 'use client' HeroCanvas wrapper component. The build error confirms server-side isolation. Pattern confirmed in Next.js 16 docs lazy-loading.md: ssr:false only works in Client Components.
